name: 泉 京助
description: 創作 人外好き マロ返→@izumi___aa

works.body:
I need you to draw me a twitter icon.

I would like you to draw one sleeping phoenix (it doesn't have to be strictly a phoenix, a huge bird...)
(Reference for the system: https://jp.mercari.com/item/m81070230514)
I would like you to make both wings so big that the legs are not visible, in the same system as in the image.

(Color reference: https://ja.pikbest.com/png-images/qiantu-ancient-chinese-style-burnt-blue-phoenix-hairpin_2721948.html)
I want the tips of the wings to be darker blue than the tips of the feathers, as in the image.
The background should be black or indigo if possible.
No nose lanterns, please.

Thank you very much.

My name is 26 and this is my first request. I am 26 and this is my first commission. I thought the illustration of a kimono you just delivered was wonderful and decided to commission one myself.
I would like to request a standing picture for a TRPG, including character design.
Please deliver a full-body drawing with a transparent background.
Here are the details

Motif, gender
We would like a girl based on the first illustration in the tweet.

Height
short

Clothing
Black gothic lolita. We would like the slit part of the skirt to be a rainbow color like the one in the second and third illustrations in the material tweets.

Hair
Hair style is up to you.
We would like her to have black hair with a purple inner color.

Eyes
We would like the eyes to be yellow-green with triangular pupils. (Image of the two hands in the motif illustration)

・Accessories
Bandages on both wrists.
Other parts are left up to you.

Shoes
Please use something like the fourth document tweet.

That's all.
I am sorry that this is a rough request and that you are busy, but thank you in advance for your cooperation.

https://x.com/26_XXVI/status/1804791982260416955?t=Upy-lsR7LT68830Ooe_Mcg&s=19

reprint

Hair color Brown

Curly, center parted, half up, long hair. Generally the same as Mary Belle of Poe's family.

Skin color
White. Caucasian white.

Facial expression: Any expression

Eye color Blue

Eyebrow color Blue

Eyelashes: Fluttering

Facial accessories None

Make-up around the eyes (lower, upper, or the entire face is up to your taste) I want it to be reddish to pinkish.

Type of clothing: Kimono!
I would like you to draw a type of kimono called "Hiki-Furisode". It is a type of kimono that is worn by layering two kimonos and dragging them on top of each other without taking the o-hashori off. It generally looks like this.
https://youtu.be/HJ3xiUMAScw?si=DAwM-T7cIQDhX0Jg
https://youtube.com/shorts/nsM1rb1mLXk?si=Tn6Mka35vXp23has
The first one in the reference video shows two kimonos docked and worn over a lintel (underwear) for simplification. I would like you to draw a pullover kimono like that. The kimono pattern is up to you, and the way it is tied is also up to you. I like both Japanese/Western mix style and orthodox obi!
Izumi Kyosuke's lines have elegance of drape and beauty of fingertips, so I would like the tips of her hands and toes to be exposed. Without tabi.

I want the tips of her hand nails to be sparkling. Nail omission is acceptable.

Poses and accessories
Leave it to me!
I like the atmosphere of Kyosuke Izumi's drawings, so I will specify only the avatar and leave the expressions and poses to you.
